hero.headline: Specializing in fine cuts, curly cuts & vintage styling.
hero.subheading: San Francisco-based stylist specializing in precision curly and fine hair cuts, as well as authentic vintage styling, with bespoke on-location services available for events and professional productions.
hero.availabilityNotice: On-location hair stylist appointments in San Francisco. Main availability is Tuesdays.

services.pricingNote: Service pricing is for San Francisco only. Additional travel fees apply for inquiries throughout the greater Bay Area.

servicesList.name: Curly Cut & Styled Finish
servicesList.description: Custom wet and or dry-cutting tailored to your unique curl pattern and density. Includes wash, deep conditioning, and step-by-step styling coaching.
deliverables: Combination wet and or dry precision curl-by-curl shaping
Diffused styling and home maintenance coaching

servicesList.name: Vintage Styling & Classic Updos
servicesList.description: Authentic victory rolls, retro waves, and pin-up styling crafted for longevity, events, swing dancing, and photo shoots.
deliverables: Precision pin placement and structural setting
Longevity finish designed for all-day wear
Accessories and hairpiece placement if needed

servicesList.name: General Haircut & Styled Finish
servicesList.description: Consultation and personalized haircut. TIps for everyday styling and product recommendations.
deliverables: Precision haircut customized for your lifestyle
